CREATE TABLE llm_providers (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	provider_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	api_key_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL, 
	base_url TEXT, 
	llm_model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	llm_small_model VARCHAR(100), 
	embedding_model VARCHAR(100), 
	reranker_model VARCHAR(100), 
	config JSONB NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	is_default BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT llm_providers_name_not_empty CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT llm_providers_valid_type CHECK (provider_type IN ('openai', 'qwen', 'gemini', 'anthropic', 'groq', 'azure_openai', 'cohere', 'mistral', 'bedrock', 'vertex', 'deepseek', 'zai')), 
	UNIQUE (name)
)

CREATE TABLE permissions (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE roles (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE task_logs (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	group_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	task_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	error_message TEXT, 
	worker_id VARCHAR, 
	retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	progress INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	result JSON, 
	message VARCHAR, 
	entity_id VARCHAR, 
	entity_type VARCHAR, 
	parent_task_id VARCHAR, 
	stopped_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE tenant_agent_configs (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	llm_model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	llm_temperature FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	pattern_learning_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	multi_level_thinking_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	max_work_plan_steps INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	tool_timeout_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	enabled_tools JSON NOT NULL, 
	disabled_tools JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE text_delta_buffer (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	message_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	delta_content TEXT, 
	event_data JSON NOT NULL, 
	sequence_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE tool_compositions (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	tools JSON NOT NULL, 
	execution_template JSON NOT NULL, 
	success_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	failure_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	usage_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE users (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	hashed_password VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	full_name VARCHAR, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	is_superuser BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE workflow_patterns (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	pattern_signature VARCHAR, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	steps_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	steps JSON NOT NULL, 
	tool_compositions JSON NOT NULL, 
	success_rate FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	success_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	failure_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	avg_execution_time_ms INTEGER, 
	usage_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	metadata_json JSON, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE api_keys (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	key_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	permissions JSON NOT NULL, 
	last_used_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE llm_usage_logs (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	provider_id UUID, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(255), 
	operation_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	model_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	prompt_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	completion_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cost_usd FLOAT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT llm_usage_logs_valid_operation CHECK (operation_type IN ('llm', 'embedding', 'rerank')), 
	CONSTRAINT llm_usage_logs_non_negative_tokens CHECK (prompt_tokens >= 0 AND completion_tokens >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(provider_id) REFERENCES llm_providers (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE notifications (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	data JSON, 
	is_read BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	action_url VARCHAR, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE provider_health (
	provider_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	last_check TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	error_message TEXT, 
	response_time_ms INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (provider_id, last_check), 
	CONSTRAINT provider_health_valid_status CHECK (status IN ('healthy', 'degraded', 'unhealthy')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(provider_id) REFERENCES llm_providers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE role_permissions (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	role_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	permission_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(role_id) REFERENCES roles (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(permission_id) REFERENCES permissions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE tenant_provider_mappings (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	provider_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	priority INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT tenant_provider_mappings_tenant_not_empty CHECK (length(trim(tenant_id)) > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT tenant_provider_mappings_unique_tenant_provider UNIQUE (tenant_id, provider_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(provider_id) REFERENCES llm_providers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE tenants (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	plan VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	max_projects INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	max_users INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	max_storage BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (slug), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE invoices (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	amount INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	period_start TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	period_end TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	paid_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	invoice_url VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE mcp_servers (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	server_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	transport_config JSON NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	discovered_tools JSON NOT NULL, 
	last_sync_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE projects (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	memory_rules JSON NOT NULL, 
	graph_config JSON NOT NULL, 
	sandbox_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	sandbox_config JSON NOT NULL, 
	is_public BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE support_tickets (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	subject VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	priority VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	resolved_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE user_roles (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	role_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(role_id) REFERENCES roles (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE user_tenants (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	permissions JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE conversations (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	agent_config JSON, 
	meta JSON, 
	message_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	workflow_pattern_id VARCHAR, 
	current_mode VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	current_plan_id VARCHAR, 
	parent_conversation_id VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id)
)

CREATE TABLE edge_type_maps (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	target_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	edge_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_edge_map_unique UNIQUE (project_id, source_type, target_type, edge_type), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id)
)

CREATE TABLE edge_types (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	schema JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_edge_type_project_name UNIQUE (project_id, name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id)
)

CREATE TABLE entity_types (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	schema JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_entity_type_project_name UNIQUE (project_id, name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id)
)

CREATE TABLE hitl_requests (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	request_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	message_id VARCHAR, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR, 
	question TEXT NOT NULL, 
	options JSON, 
	context JSON, 
	request_metadata JSON, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	response TEXT, 
	response_metadata JSON, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	answered_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE memories (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	content_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	tags JSON NOT NULL, 
	entities JSON NOT NULL, 
	relationships JSON NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	author_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	collaborators JSON NOT NULL, 
	is_public BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	processing_status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	meta JSON NOT NULL, 
	task_id VARCHAR, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(author_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE project_sandboxes (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sandbox_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sandbox_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_accessed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	health_checked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	error_message TEXT, 
	metadata_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	local_config JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE skills (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	trigger_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	trigger_patterns JSON NOT NULL, 
	tools JSON NOT NULL, 
	prompt_template TEXT, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	success_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	failure_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	metadata_json JSON, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	scope VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	is_system_skill BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	full_content TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id)
)

CREATE TABLE subagents (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	system_prompt TEXT NOT NULL, 
	trigger_description TEXT, 
	trigger_examples JSON, 
	trigger_keywords JSON, 
	model VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	color VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	allowed_tools JSON NOT NULL, 
	allowed_skills JSON NOT NULL, 
	allowed_mcp_servers JSON NOT NULL, 
	max_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	temperature FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	max_iterations INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	total_invocations INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	avg_execution_time_ms FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	success_rate FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	metadata_json JSON, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), 
	UNIQUE (name)
)

CREATE TABLE tool_environment_variables (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR, 
	tool_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	variable_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	encrypted_value TEXT NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	is_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	is_secret BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	scope VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_tool_env_var_tenant_project_tool_name UNIQUE (tenant_id, project_id, tool_name, variable_name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE user_projects (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	permissions JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id)
)

CREATE TABLE agent_execution_events (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	message_id VARCHAR, 
	event_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	event_data JSON NOT NULL, 
	sequence_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_agent_events_conv_seq UNIQUE (conversation_id, sequence_number), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id)
)

CREATE TABLE attachments (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	mime_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	object_key VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	upload_id VARCHAR(200), 
	total_parts INTEGER, 
	uploaded_parts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sandbox_path VARCHAR(500), 
	file_metadata JSON, 
	error_message TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE execution_checkpoints (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	message_id VARCHAR, 
	checkpoint_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	execution_state JSON NOT NULL, 
	step_number INTEGER, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id)
)

CREATE TABLE memory_shares (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	memory_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	share_token VARCHAR, 
	shared_with_user_id VARCHAR, 
	shared_with_project_id VARCHAR, 
	permissions JSON NOT NULL, 
	shared_by VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	access_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(memory_id) REFERENCES memories (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(shared_with_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(shared_with_project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(shared_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE messages (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	message_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	tool_calls JSON, 
	tool_results JSON, 
	meta JSON, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	work_plan_ref VARCHAR, 
	task_step_index INTEGER, 
	thought_level VARCHAR(10), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id)
)

CREATE TABLE plan_documents (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	metadata_json JSON, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE tenant_skill_configs (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	system_skill_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	override_skill_id VARCHAR, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_tenant_skill_config UNIQUE (tenant_id, system_skill_name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(override_skill_id) REFERENCES skills (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE work_plans (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	steps JSON NOT NULL, 
	current_step_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	completed_step_indices JSON NOT NULL, 
	workflow_pattern_id VARCHAR, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id)
)

CREATE TABLE agent_executions (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	message_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	thought TEXT, 
	action VARCHAR(100), 
	observation TEXT, 
	tool_name VARCHAR(100), 
	tool_input JSON, 
	tool_output TEXT, 
	meta JSON, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	work_level_thought TEXT, 
	task_level_thought TEXT, 
	plan_steps JSON, 
	current_step_index INTEGER, 
	workflow_pattern_id VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(message_id) REFERENCES messages (id)
)

CREATE TABLE message_execution_status (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	message_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	last_event_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	error_message TEXT, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (message_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(message_id) REFERENCES messages (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE plan_executions (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	plan_id VARCHAR, 
	execution_mode VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	max_parallel_steps INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	reflection_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	max_reflection_cycles INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	current_reflection_cycle INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	steps JSON NOT NULL, 
	current_step_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	completed_step_indices JSON NOT NULL, 
	failed_step_indices JSON NOT NULL, 
	workflow_pattern_id VARCHAR, 
	metadata_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(plan_id) REFERENCES plan_documents (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE tool_execution_records (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	message_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	call_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tool_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	tool_input JSON, 
	tool_output TEXT, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	error TEXT, 
	step_number INTEGER, 
	sequence_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	duration_ms INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(message_id) REFERENCES messages (id)
)

CREATE TABLE plan_snapshots (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	execution_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	step_states JSON NOT NULL, 
	auto_created BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	metadata_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(execution_id) REFERENCES plan_executions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
